'''Keikou Sakai''' (Japanese: '''酒井敬幸''' ''Sakai Keikō'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Sakai was born sometime on December 25, in {{wp|Fukushima, Hokkaido}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|RS}}, but his first notable role was during {{aniseries|SM}}, where he voiced [[Team Rocket]] agent [[Gozu]]. Sakai is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|81 Produce}}.
